nocturne.description:
Nocturne is an open-source music player that streams from YouTube Music, SoundCloud and Spotify in one app, with no ads. Spotify tracks are matched and played from YouTube Music.

Key features:
- Search and browse songs, albums, playlists and artists across all sources; paste or share music links straight into the app
- Endless radio: when the queue ends, similar songs keep playing
- Synced lyrics with tap-to-seek, translation and a karaoke mode
- Equalizer with presets, playback speed, Slowed + Reverb and Nightcore versions, DJ-style transitions between songs
- Listen together with friends: shared queue, chat and song voting; playlists you edit together
- Offline downloads, sleep timer, Android Auto, Material You colours and several alternative designs
- Optional sign-in to YouTube Music, Spotify or SoundCloud to sync your likes and playlists

Built with Kotlin Multiplatform; also available for Windows, Linux and iOS. Requires Android 8.0+.
